# Atelier Nova

> Atelier Nova is a demo fashion storefront with no pages: every screen — the
> personalized home, the catalog, the interactive fitting room, the order flow —
> is generated at runtime by BranderUX from an AI agent's answers. The entire
> frontend is one component; the repo is an open-source reference for building
> full agentic applications.

Atelier Nova demonstrates "generative UI" / "agentic commerce": instead of a
chatbot answering in text, the agent's answers become branded, interactive
screens. Clicks flow back to the agent as new queries, so the interface and the
conversation are the same loop. The screens are composed from pre-built,
brand-styled elements (not code generation at runtime), which guarantees brand
fidelity and safety while the AI decides composition and data.

Built with [BranderUX](https://branderux.com) — AI-UX infrastructure that turns
any AI agent into a full branded application, website or MCP app.

## Pages

- [Home](/) — the live demo (client-rendered BranderUX surface)
- [How it works](/about) — architecture, screenshots, FAQ

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BranderUX/atelier-nova) — the complete
  storefront: a Next.js shell, one agent API route, the custom element sources,
  and the seed script that provisions the BranderUX project.
- [BranderUX](https://branderux.com) — the platform generating the screens.
- [@brander/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@brander/sdk) — the NPM package
  embedding the surface.
